newsitem.title: USA: Delta gets approval for Brazil routes.
newsitem.headline: Delta gets approval for Brazil routes.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said on Friday that it has received U.S. Department of Transportation approval to begin daily round trip flights to Brazil from Cincinnati and Atlanta, but a route between New York and Brazil was rejected.

"This new Cincinnati to Atlanta to Brazil award will be the foundation for Delta's entry into South America," Vince Caminiti, Delta's senior vice president - sales and international, said in a statement.
Delta said it will pursue a route from New York's JFK airport to Brazil sometime in the future.
Delta will terminate its code-share agreement with VARIG Brazilian Airlines on June 14 for all southbound flights and June 15 for all northbound flights, it said.
Southbound flights to Sao Paulo and Rio de Janeiro will begin June 15 and northbound flights will begin the following day, Delta said.
